notes.title: Join our community and help shape Demon Bluff!
notes.content:
Step into the ritual circle and help us shape what comes next
We’re inviting you to join our community and help shape the development of Demon Bluff.

Public playtests are coming soon, but in the meantime, we’d love to hear your thoughts, ideas, and feedback!

🗨️ Join our Discord here:
https://discord.gg/shGVFhjJMe

Inside, you’ll find:

 Playable prototype
 A place to share feedback and suggestions
 Game design discussions
 Sneak peeks of new cards and game mechanics
 A group of other sharp-minded deduction fans
 A direct line to the dev



Whether you are a fan of deduction games, card games, roguelikes, or stylish dark fantasy — we’d love to hear what you think and build a better game together.

See you in the circle. 🔥

Cheers,
- Piotr
